name: Posterior Interosseous Nerve Syndrome
category: Neurology/Orthopedics > Peripheral Nerve > Radial Motor Branch
definition: Motor neuropathy of the posterior interosseous nerve causing finger and thumb extension weakness, typically without cutaneous sensory loss.

typical: Wrist extension may be preserved with radial deviation

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostic testing and ultrasound/MRI are used to localize compression or mass when needed.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent severe motor deficit or structural compression may require surgical decompression.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neuropathy phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Motor neuropathy of the posterior interosseous nerve causing finger and thumb extension weakness, typically without cutaneous sensory loss.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
